name: Viking
blurb: Viking is a free/open source program to manage GPS data.
description:
Viking is a free/open source program to manage GPS data.

Viking includes the following features:

• Import GPX, TCX, KML and KMZ files

• Export to GPX and KMZ files

• Import and Export numerous file types via GPSBabel

• Create and edit Tracks, Routes and Waypoints

• Show OpenTopoMap, OpenStreetMap(OSM) Maps and various other Maps from online providers

• Show Generic Map Images with World File definitions

• Upload/Download OSM Traces

• Geotag Images

• Follow Realtime GPS Position

• Visualization and Statistics

• Digitial Elevation Model (DEM) Support

• OSRM Routing Support

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
